items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: Well, I knew Shep Allen, but no, I don't know these other fellows.

ctx.x: Brooks Kerr, a young man in New York, asked me to ask you about Shep Allen.
Shep Allen? He was the manager of the Howard Theatre. I imagine he is still there, I don't know.
And then Brooks said Hernandez, who was a violinist.
